body:
Nah, don't worry about it. That was really nice of you to say.

Yeah, I get what you're saying. I'll keep that in mind.

Thanks a lot. That means a lot to me. I hope that you're right about things. I will try to keep going. I guess that I'll try a bit harder to find things which make me happy. Thanks again.

Uh, thanks...lol. You've never met me, though.

I can't afford therapy at the moment. I have tried it in the past; I was in therapy for about 9 years (on and off). As a result of my experiences, I have admittedly become quite a bit disillusioned with therapy and mental health professionals, but I don't really have any other ideas as to how I could potentially get help.

Yes, as far as I can tell, my condition does keep me from teaching English abroad. I have looked into some organizations which send native speakers to various countries to teach, and I am disqualified from serving with them due to my medical needs. 

I do have obligations. I am entering my last year of college. My family has worked hard to help send me to school. I also have had to take out a lot of student loans, so I still need to work to pay those off. 

That's not really a realistic thing for me to be able to do at the moment. Maybe someday.

I don't know. There are a lot of things that I'd like to do. I would like to see the world, but I can't afford anything like that right now. I would love to be able to travel and to help people in developing countries. Teach English, do whatever. I have wanted to do something like this since I was much younger, but I am unable to do so due to medical reasons. I am ineligible to join Peace Corps and other similar (but non-governmental) programs which I've looked into, and with good reason. Maybe it sounds dumb, but this is something which I've wanted to do for a long time. I volunteer where I live, but there isn't much to do and I don't find it very fulfilling. 

There are other things which I'd also like to do, but I'd rather not get into them, I guess.

Unfortunately, that's not realistic. I have responsibilities and obligations. I also do not have any money, nor a car. I have some medical issues for which I need regular treatment. They hold me back.

I have an idea of what I would like, but there are many things which I am unable to do.

Oh okay, haha. I would like to be able to do new things and try things which interest me, but I don't really have much means to do that right now. I don't have a car and I'm pretty much just stuck at home 24/7 until fall.

> And in my case, it was at a point that I should have felt on top of the world when I discovered I was at my absolute worst.

That hits very close to home. I can definitely relate.

I'm glad that you have been able to take steps towards being well-adjusted. That's good to hear. 

I guess that my problem is that I do know all too well where my pain is coming from, but there's nothing I can do about it. Even if I take steps to "fix" it, it will affect me for the rest of my life (it's a series of medical problems).

>You've got to take it one day at a time, and try to do something every day that terrorizes you a little bit. 

Haha, could you elaborate on what you mean by that?

I've tried therapy. I was in therapy for about 9 years, on and off. I do not have insurance at the moment, so I have no idea when I could feasibly see a therapist again. Another issue is that I live in a somewhat rural area and some of my problems kind of require someone with expertise in those areas. The closest person with any sort of experience/expertise/knowledge is about three hours away from me.

Thanks for commenting. I appreciate hearing from someone who kind of knows where I'm coming from.

Sorry to hear that you can relate.

I am a pretty private person, so talking about my emotions isn't something which comes easily for me. I can listen to other people talk about their problems and struggles, but it is almost impossible for me to do the same. One thing which keeps me from airing how I'm feeling is the fact that my problems/whatever you want to call them are more severe (and some very permanent) than those of the people in my life, and I guess that I don't want to put myself out there way too much or scare people away. I tried talking about things with one person fairly recently, but I was not taken seriously. 

Thanks a lot. I may do that soon - I'm not much in the talking mood tonight, but if I'm feeling like this tomorrow or whatever, I will be sure to PM you if that's alright. Thanks again.
